tools.office_editor.empty_title: Open an Office document to start
tools.office_editor.empty_desc: Open a Word / Excel / PowerPoint document via system double-click, drag & drop, or the button below; viewing and light editing supported.
tools.office_editor.err_file_too_large: File is too large ({{size}}); the limit is {{max}}. Unable to open.
tools.office_editor.load_failed: Failed to load document (it may be corrupted or password-protected): {{message}}
tools.office_editor.readonly_large: Large sheet, view only (editing disabled above 2000 rows or 100 columns)
tools.office_editor.edited_hint: After editing, use "Export as xlsx" to save a new file; the original is not overwritten
tools.office_editor.pptx_simple_hint: Light preview: shows text and images per slide; layout/animations are not reproduced
tools.office_editor.legacy_desc: This is a 97-2003 binary format (shared by Microsoft Office and WPS) which browser-side libraries cannot parse; please convert it to a modern format and reopen.
tools.office_editor.legacy_step1: Open the file in Microsoft Office or WPS
tools.office_editor.legacy_step2: Save it as the modern equivalent (docx / xlsx / pptx)
tools.office_editor.legacy_step3: Reopen the converted file in Qraft
